segments.name: North America
segments.description: Manufactures and sells food and beverage products including condiments, sauces, cheese, meats, snacks, and ready meals for North American consumers.
segments.evidence: Significant trademarks by segment based on net sales in 2025 were: Majority Owned and Licensed Trademarks North America Kraft, Oscar Mayer, Heinz, Philadelphia, Lunchables, Velveeta, Ore-Ida, Capri Sun*, Maxwell House, Kool-Aid, Jell-O

segments.name: International Developed Markets
segments.description: Manufactures and sells food and beverage products across Europe and Pacific developed markets under established heritage brands.
segments.evidence: We have two reportable segments defined by geographic region: North America and International Developed Markets.

segments.name: Emerging Markets
segments.description: Manufactures and sells food and beverage products in West, East, and Asia emerging markets under various regional and global brands.
segments.evidence: Our remaining operating segments, consisting of WEEM and AEM, are combined and disclosed as Emerging Markets.

revenueModel.text: Consumers and institutions pay for food and beverage products sold through retailers, distributors, foodservice channels, and e-commerce platforms.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold through our own sales organizations and through independent brokers, agents, and distributors to chain, wholesale, cooperative, and independent grocery accounts; convenience, value, and club stores; pharmacies and drug stores; mass merchants; foodservice distributors; and institutions, including hotels, restaurants, bakeries, hospitals, health care facilities, and government agencies.

changes.text: In 2025, the company divested its infant and specialty food business in Italy, including the Plasmon brand intellectual property rights.
changes.evidence: On December 31, 2025, in the first quarter of our fiscal year 2026, we divested our infant and specialty food business in Italy, which included our intellectual property rights to the Plasmon brand.
